settings.heading: Keeps the signal clean
settings.body: Potassium moves fluid in and out of your cells and helps muscles contract and nerves fire. Orange, beet, and leafy greens all carry it.

settings.heading: Turns food into fuel
settings.body: Magnesium is a cofactor in the reactions that produce ATP, the molecule your cells actually spend as energy. Dark greens are one of the better food sources.

settings.heading: Water that stays put
settings.body: Plain water passes through. Water arriving with sodium, potassium, and natural sugars is absorbed more efficiently, which is the principle behind oral rehydration.

settings.heading: Fuel with instructions
settings.body: Fructose and glucose from whole fruit come packaged with vitamins, minerals, and plant compounds. Same sugar, entirely different delivery.

settings.heading: Nothing cooked off
settings.body: Heat pasteurization extends shelf life but degrades some vitamins and enzymes. Cold-pressing trades shelf life for keeping more of what was in the fruit.

settings.heading: Nothing to come down from
settings.body: There is no stimulant in the bottle, so there is no rebound. What you feel is hydration and fuel doing their job.

settings.title: Energy you don't crash out of
settings.lede: Caffeine borrows energy against later. Fruit sugar arrives with the water, minerals, and enzymes your body needs to actually use it.
settings.compare_a_text: Fast spike, hard landing. Stimulants push the system and leave you paying the difference an hour later.
settings.compare_b_text: A steadier climb that holds. Natural sugars arrive with the minerals that help your body put them to work.
settings.footnote: General nutrition information, not medical advice.

settings.title: The more you take home, the less each one costs
settings.text: Every bottle is pressed the same morning. Slide to see where your order lands.
settings.fine_print: Estimate only. Final pricing depends on recipe and delivery window.

settings.title: Deliciously different
settings.subtitle: Small batch, same morning, every time
settings.text: We press in small runs so nothing sits. The fruit comes in, it goes through the press, and it goes out the door the same day. That is the whole method, and it is why the bottle tastes like the fruit it came from.

settings.heading: Organic produce
settings.body: Certified organic fruit and vegetables, sourced through regional growers and produce partners around the metro.

settings.heading: Pressed cold
settings.body: No heat, no shortcuts. The press runs in the morning and bottles go out the same day.

settings.heading: Small runs and full cases
settings.body: Five bottles for the week or fifty for a standing account. Same juice either way.

settings.title: Where the fruit comes from
settings.lede: Organic first, local when the season allows, and never from concentrate.
